question:
The bar graph given here shows the data of the production of cars by three different companies X, Y, Z over the years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7155fd2a79324d9220981db6685e08ec543ace88df04c0a56f84d98390771fe2.png] 

The average production for 5 years was maximum for which company/companies?
solution:
**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Total production of company X over 5 years = 30 + 45 + 25 + 50 + 40 = 190

Average production over 5 years = (190)/(5) = 38 cars

Total production of company Y over 5 years = 25 + 35 + 35 + 40 + 50 = 185
